title: SubmissionCreateRequest
description: Request body for POST /v1/submissions. Server returns a full Submission (202 Accepted).

requested_capabilities.description: Capability IDs to request (e.g. vulnerability, malware). If omitted, no provider is invoked.

provider_selectors.description: Optional provider selection hints (required/optional, min_providers_per_capability, etc.).

policy_ref.description: Reference to a consumer policy. If absent, the submission completes with completion_reason=findings_only and no PolicyDecision.

then.description: v1 invariant: content_ref without digests is rejected. A bare URL is never a valid artifact identity.
